correction: The earlier Minkowski note compared a physical null geodesic approaching scri with a generator lying in scri. These are not the same curve, so that note alone is not a counterexample to completeness of scri generators.
remaining_issue: F1 i_plus.completeness_definition calls the following equivalent without stating a conformal gauge/normalization theorem: (a) completeness of null generators intrinsic to I+ in the unphysical metric gtilde; (b) divergence of physical affine parameter for null geodesics of (M,g) reaching I+. The relation requires explicit hypotheses and a precise convention; it is not a definitional identity.
standard_distinction: In conformal compactification, gtilde=Omega^2 g and null curves agree only as unparametrized curves. The physical geodesic affine parameter and an unphysical affine parameter transform by a conformal-factor integral. Completeness of scri generators is convention-dependent on the chosen conformal completion; physical affine divergence is a separate asymptotic statement.

Or state a precise theorem with hypotheses and distinguish the two curve classes explicitly.
